name: todo-planner
description: Tally: a personal to-do list and planner (Electron desktop app, own SQLite database).

scripts.start: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && PLANNER_DEMO=1 PLANNER_SELFTEST=/tmp/planner-smoke.png electron .
scripts.smoke:ui: npm run seed && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && node scripts/seed-fake-reminders.mjs /tmp/planner-fake-reminders.json && PLANNER_FAKE_REMINDERS=/tmp/planner-fake-reminders.json PLANNER_DEMO=1 PLANNER_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS=300 PLANNER_SELFTEST=/tmp/planner-ui.png PLANNER_SELFTEST_SCRIPT=scripts/smoke-ui.js electron . && PLANNER_DEMO=1 PLANNER_SELFTEST=/tmp/planner-ui2.png PLANNER_SELFTEST_SCRIPT=scripts/smoke-restart.js electron . && PLANNER_DEMO=1 PLANNER_SELFTEST_QUICK_SCRIPT=scripts/smoke-quick.js electron . && PLANNER_DEMO=1 PLANNER_SELFTEST_TRAY=1 electron . && node scripts/quit-flow-check.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && node scripts/make-icon.mjs --if-missing && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && node scripts/sign-app.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.smoke:mcp: npm run seed && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && node scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs

build.copyright: Personal planner, built for local use

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Tally reads the open reminders in your "Tally Inbox" list in Reminders, turns each into a task, and marks it completed. It never touches any other list.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Tally reads the open reminders in your "Tally Inbox" list in Reminders, turns each into a task, and marks it completed. It never touches any other list.
